question: At the 2026 Oscars, Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor for the film Sinners, and commentators immediately compared his win to Lee Marvin's 1966 Oscar for Cat Ballou. What did the two award-winning performances have in common?
alternative_answers: they each played two roles in one film
both won for playing more than one character
source_excerpt: Michael B. Jordan Is the 2nd Actor to Win Oscar for Playing Twins

extra.verification_notes: Jordan (Smoke/Stack) and Marvin (Kid Shelleen/Tim Strawn, twin brothers) both won Best Actor for playing twins, per TheWrap coverage; no newer event contradicts it.

explanation: In Sinners, Michael B. Jordan plays twin brothers Smoke and Stack, two distinct lead roles in the same film. When he won Best Actor at the 98th Academy Awards in March 2026, he became only the second performer to win an Oscar for a dual role. The first was Lee Marvin, who won Best Actor for the 1965 western Cat Ballou, in which he played both the drunken gunfighter Kid Shelleen and the silver-nosed villain Tim Strawn. Playing two characters in one film has historically been seen as a stunt rather than awards material, which is why the comparison was so widely made.

question: The Pitt, which won the Emmy for Outstanding Drama Series in both 2025 and 2026, titles its episodes with clock times like "7:00 A.M." and gives every season exactly 15 episodes. What rule behind the show's format explains both of these choices?

alternative_answers: Each episode is one hour in real time
Real-time format, one hour per episode
Each episode equals one hour of a single shift
The show plays out in real time across one shift

question: Disney's Zootopia 2 opened in late November 2025 with a global debut that was the biggest ever for an animated film at that time. Yet the headline figure covered five days, not the usual three-day weekend. Why five days?
correct_answer: It opened Wednesday before US Thanksgiving
alternative_answers: Released on a Wednesday for the holiday
Midweek holiday opening, Wednesday to Sunday
US Thanksgiving falls on Thursday so it opened Wednesday
Holiday releases count Wednesday through Sunday
headline_answer: It opened Wednesday before US Thanksgiving
source_excerpt: opened in the United States on November 26, 2025. The five-day Thanksgiving opening in the U.S. and Canada was $158.8 million, and the worldwide opening was $560.3 million.

topicality.rationale: Box-office opening detail of a big film release; fades after the season.

extra.verification_notes: Zootopia 2 opened Wednesday Nov 26, 2025, the day before Thanksgiving, giving a five-day record animated global opening; the question's 'at that time' wording avoids staleness (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zootopia_2).

explanation: Zootopia 2 was released on Wednesday 26 November 2025, the day before the US Thanksgiving holiday. Thanksgiving releases traditionally open on Wednesday so the long holiday weekend counts as one extended frame, so studios and trade press report a five-day Wednesday-to-Sunday figure instead of the standard Friday-to-Sunday weekend. That five-day haul of roughly 559 million dollars worldwide was the largest global opening for an animated film at the time, and the film went on to pass one billion dollars.
